comment: The ratchet floor for the competitor matrix: MISSING may fall and may not rise.
INVALID is recorded by name, because it says what this MACHINE could not measure rather than what this COMMIT did not do.
indexing.secondsPerMillionLines: the artifact sets valid:false because the run hit its timeout - a lower bound, not a rate.
retrieval.docstring.recall.withVectors: the artifact reports backend:none, so no embedding model was installed for that run.
